title: ReactOS 0.4.16
summary: ReactOS 0.4.16 is the latest release of a free, open-source operating system designed to be binary-compatible with Microsoft Windows, allowing Windows applications and drivers to run natively without requiring a Windows license.
problem_solved: Provides a free Windows-compatible operating system for running Windows software without purchasing Windows licenses.
why_valuable: Enables users to run Windows applications on open-source infrastructure, supporting legacy software preservation and reducing software dependency on proprietary systems.
